subject: Next steps: QuestAI POC — success criteria & capacity plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@questai.com>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@questai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: QuestAI POC — success criteria & capacity plan

Hi Samantha / Rajiv,

Thanks for the call this morning — good alignment on scope. Below is a concise recap and the proposed next steps so we have clear ownership going into the trial:

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Goal: Validate that QuestAI can reduce end-to-end document summarization latency under 800ms p95 while maintaining ROUGE-L >= 0.78 on your internal corpus.
- Workloads: Mixed real-time inference (OEM web UI) + nightly batch embedding refresh for search indexes (approx 120k docs/day).
- Security: Vault-backed KMS + VPC peering required for the private deployment test; PCI/PHI not in scope.

Success criteria (proposed — please confirm):
1) Latency: p95 generation < 800ms for 1–2k concurrent sessions during peak tests.
2) Quality: no regression > 5% in your internal evaluation set (ROUGE-L baseline provided by Rajiv).
3) Cost & throughput: sustained throughput of 600 tokens/sec with <10% tail increase during burst windows.
4) Ops: end-to-end monitoring including per-route latency dashboards and alerting on token cost drift.

Capacity ask for POC
- Reserved baseline: 4x A40-equivalent GPUs (or 2x A100-80GB equivalency) to support steady-state realtime plus batch overlap.
- Burst: ability to scale to +100% compute for 30m windows (automated autoscale with 10–15s cold-start mitigation).

Files attached: capacity_plan_v1.xlsx (baseline numbers + burst model), redwood_poc_sow_draft.pdf (POC scope + milestones).

Proposed timeline & owners
- Week 0 (this week): SOW finalization, infra access & VPC peering (Owners: Mina / Rajiv).
- Week 1: Provisioning + baseline runs (Owners: Marcus / Dev).
- Week 2: Integration tests + quality evals (Owners: QuestAI engineering + Marcus).
- Week 3: Burst stress & final acceptance (Owners: Mina / Rajiv).

Immediate asks for QuestAI
- Confirm the success criteria above or send edits by EOD Thursday.
- Share the baseline ROUGE-L scores Rajiv mentioned and a sample of anonymized docs for an initial run.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min sync for Thursday to lock the SOW and capacity commit.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Next steps: QuestAI POC — success criteria & capacity plan

Mina — thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Success criteria: Agreed on latency and quality targets as written. We will aim to deliver the ROUGE-L baseline by tomorrow EOD.
- Capacity: The baseline numbers look reasonable. We can commit to the reserved baseline if Redwood can guarantee the burst scaling window you outlined for the stress tests.
- Timeline: Thursday sync works — we have internal stakeholders available at 10:00am PT.

A couple of notes/questions:
1) Cold-start mitigation — can you share expected warmup time for the quantized variant you plan to run? We want to ensure user-facing sessions don't see the first-request spike.
2) Data sharing — we'll provide a 5k-doc anonymized sample to start; is that sufficient for the initial quality eval?

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Head of Product, QuestAI
[samantha@questai.com]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@questai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@questai.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T07:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: QuestAI POC — success criteria & capacity plan

Samantha — quick technical answers and a small tweak to the plan.

Warmup / cold-start: For the 8-bit quantized model we recommend a persistent warm pool approach. Expected warmup to usable latency ~8–12s for the first JVM/container spin; subsequent requests will hit steady-state. We can pre-warm on deploy to avoid the first-user spike during the demo.

Autoscaling & burst behavior:
- Autoscale trigger: CPU + GPU utilization with token-rate baselining.
- Scale unit: add 1 GPU per scale step; we can target scale steps every 30s with a max ramp to +100% within ~3 minutes.
- Fallback: automatic routing to a lower-latency but lower-accuracy variant if we hit 5xx/timeout thresholds during burst tests.

Suggested tweak: bump reserved baseline to 6x A40-equivalents for the first two weeks of the POC so we can run parallel integration and batch refresh without queueing. We will mark 2 GPUs as "pre-warm" for session-heavy tests. If QuestAI is comfortable, we can include a one-time promotional credit to offset incremental cost for weeks 0–2.

I'll attach the short capacity worksheet slice and a perf-run checklist in the Drive folder.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
